Name: FijiAllergyAgentVS
Title: Allergy Causative Agent Value Set for Fiji Patient
Description: A subset of SNOMED CT concepts representing substances or products that cause allergies or intolerances, aligned with global IPS.

Name: FijiBodyPositionVS
Title: Body Position value set
Description: SELECT SNOMED CT code system values the position in which the individual was in during a measurement.

Name: FijiBodySiteVS
Title: Fiji Body Site (Anatomical Structure) Value Set
Description: Valueset for bodysite/anatomical structures. Used for Condition.bodySite and Immunization.site Values from SNOMED CT anatomical structures.

Name: FijiConditionCodeVS
Title: Condition/Diagnosis code valueset
Description: Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core.  Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary. Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".

Name: FijiDCMModalityVS
Title: Fiji Dicom Imaging Modality Value Set
Description: Imaging acquisition modalities based on DICOM CID 29.

Name: FijiDivisionVS
Title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration Divisions
Description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration Divisions

Name: FijiEncounterReasonVS
Title: Encounter reason code valueset
Description: Encounter reason valueset for Fiji Core.  Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED descendant of clinical findings and Procedures.

Name: FijiEvidenceVS
Title: Condition Evidence Value Set for Fiji Core IG
Description: Evidence: Signs, symptoms, procedures, and labs, explicitly excluding formal diseases.

Name: FijiKorodinaVS
Title: Fiji Korodina ValueSet
Description: The set of korodina codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: FijiMataqaliVS
Title: Fiji Mataqali ValueSet
Description: Mataqali codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: FijiMedVS
Title: Fiji Medication ValueSet
Description: Fiji Medication valueset based on until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed

Name: FijiMedicalAreaVS
Title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration medical areas
Description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration  medical areas

Name: FijiMedicationRequestReasonVS
Title: MedicationRequest reason code valueset
Description: MedicationRequest reason valueset for Fiji Core.  Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED Problem/Diagnosis refsets.

Name: FijiMedicationRouteVS
Title: Fiji Medication and Vaccine Route Value Set
Description: Valueset for medication and vaccine route. Used for Medications and Immunization.route Values are descendants from SNOMED CT Route of Administration concept.

Name: FijiNursingZoneVS
Title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration nursing zones
Description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration  nursing zones

Name: FijiObsInterpretationVS
Title: Fiji Observation Interpretation Value Set
Description: Valueset for interpretations of Observations for Fiji. Used for interpretaton element for Observations and derived profiles (eg. Vital signs) Values from  HL7 v3 Code System ObservationInterpretation with added values from WHO/Fiji usage.

Name: FijiOrganizationRoleVS
Title: Fiji Healthcare Organization Role Type Value Set
Description: Valueset for Healthcare Organization Role Type. Values from SNOMED CT Hospital environment, Site of care, Outpatient environment, and Inpatient environment.

Name: FijiRadiologyFindingsVS
Title: Fiji Radiology/Diagnostic Findings Value Set
Description: Fiji radiology findings including SNOMED CT concepts filtered for radiology and imaging findings used within an IPS context.

Name: FijiServiceTypeVS
Title: Service Type code valueset
Description: Service Type valueset for Fiji Core.  Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED Services codes.

Name: FijiSubDivisionVS
Title: Valueset of Fiji Health Administration Sub-divisions
Description: A valueset containing Fiji Health Administration sub-divisions

Name: FijiTikinaVS
Title: Fiji Tikina ValueSet
Description: The set of tikina codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: FijiTokatokaVS
Title: Fiji Tokatoka ValueSet
Description: Tokatoka codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: FijiVitalBodyWeightVS
Title: Fiji Vital Sign Body Weight ValueSet
Description: Concepts representing options that provide further context for body weight coding. (eg.  Birth Weight...) NOTE: This is not currently used but may be used in future when a full valueset has been developed

Name: FijiVitalMethodVS
Title: Fiji Vital Sign Measurement Method ValueSet
Description: SNOMED CT concepts representing methods used to obtain vital sign measurements, including body temperature, blood pressure, body height, body weight, heart rate, oxygen saturation and respiratory rate. This may be extended as required including with local codes used in historic data.

Name: FijiYasanaVS
Title: Fiji Yasana ValueSet
Description: The set of yasana codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: FijiYavusaVS
Title: Fiji Yavusa ValueSet
Description: The set of yavusa codes recognised by the Fiji Implementation Guide.

Name: HeartRateVS
Title: Heart Rate LOINC Codes
Description: LOINC codes for heart rate measurements, spot or average.

Name: ImmVS
Title: Immunization ValueSet
Description: Immunization valueset based on until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed

Name: ImmStatusReasonVS
Title: Immunization Status Reason valueset for reason a vaccine was not administered
Description: Status Reason codes for reason a vaccine was not administered.  Initial codes used are ICD-11 codes from DAK. TODO: Converted and/or extend from vaccine specific exception codes from SNOMED CT codes or whatever code system chosen

Name: ObsVS
Title: Observation ValueSet
Description: Use all LOINC codes as temporary observation valueset until Fiji-Pacific valueset is developed
